title: Fuchsian Resonance and a Horizon-to-Boundary Dictionary for Pole-Skipping
summary: Pole-skipping occurs at special complex frequencies and momenta where the retarded Green function of a black-hole or black-brane background is not uniquely defined. The local near-horizon mechanism is well known: at resonance, a Frobenius recurrence matrix loses rank and the space of smooth horizon solutions enlarges. We address the global question of how two boundary-normalized solutions enter this resonant horizon solution space.
